study: Duncan et al. 2018, Math for All (EDC, IES R305A140488)
eval_evidence: Study conducted and authored by Education Development Center (EDC) staff (Moeller et al.), the program's developer/grantee (IES grant awarded to EDC).
developer_evidence: 'MFA developers deliver' the PD; MFA is 'intended to be co-facilitated by two staff developers'; in this study facilitation was 'either by the developers or by district-based staff' but developer-delivered is the design.
cascade_evidence: PD co-facilitated by two EDC staff developers working directly with the grade 4-5 teachers (5 one-day workshops); no train-the-trainer cascade for this study's delivery.
counterfactual_evidence: Explicit BAU control across RQ1-3 ('compared to business-as-usual (BAU) experiences of a control group'); no active alternative math PD given to controls.
coaching_evidence: MFA = 5 one-day workshops + classroom-based assignments (~50 hrs); the listed 'peer coaching' and 'lesson study' are teacher-collaboration activities within the model, not ongoing external in-class coaching cycles.
student_dose_evidence: MFA changes teachers' math instruction/differentiation; not curriculum- or student-dose-based ('not focused on delivery of a specific curriculum'); no tutoring/pull-out/software for students.
maturity_evidence: Extracted Year-1 (2015-2016) results are the implementation year; 'the first year of the study (2015-2016) was intended to be the implementation year' with teachers new to MFA (Year 2 excluded for attrition).
